sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Link previews: a MusicBrainz label's window (on MusicBrainz, and from the MusicBrainz column on discogs.com) shows its links on the left, under its facts, as an artist's window does; the right side keeps the related labels, people, places and series.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: The label kind's windowHtml puts _mbPopUrlLinksTableHtml() after the facts in the first column. Test: popup-mb.spec.js "the label card and window"; scripts/mutations/poh-fixes.json (+1, caught). docs/claude/detail-pages.md, HELP.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Link previews: in a tag's window, each kind under "By kind" now says what a click does when you rest the pointer on it, e.g. "Show the 661,243 recordings tagged rock on the right, most votes first: the first 100 now, 100 more a page on demand"; the kind already listed says so. An editor's tag window names the editor.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: _mbTagKindTip() gives each mb-pop-kindbtn its data-mb-tip text in _mbPopTagWindowHtml(); _MB_POP_TAG_KIND_PAGE (100). Tests: popup-mb.spec.js and popup-mb-user-lists.spec.js assert the words; scripts/mutations/poh-fixes.json (4, all caught). docs/claude/detail-pages.md, HELP.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Page heading: the ❌ errors and ⚠️ warnings buttons, and 🔄 when pages failed to load, moved out of the SAED button into a small rounded bar of their own right after it. The SAED button keeps the same shape on every page; the second bar appears only when the page has something to show. ⚠️ still shows at 0 where it starts the title-style check.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: The attn area is the one area of #mb-saed-attn-bar (class mb-saed-bar, the same custom properties), built next to #mb-saed-bar and held in _saedAttnBarEl; _saedAreaFor() resolves attn there, _saedMarkFirst() marks each bar, _orderToolbar() hides the bar while it is empty (.mb-saed-bar[hidden], since the bar's display beats the browser's own rule), and _TOOLBAR_TAIL_ORDER names both bars. Approved mockup https://claude.ai/artifact/URrn3dps1EMtnkjKBvsvag. Tests: saed-toolbar, findings-menus (placement, rounded corners, hidden when empty) and fetch-in-segment updated; scripts/mutations/saed-attn-bar.json (6, all caught). docs/claude/toolbar-and-header-ui.md, findings.md, CLAUDE.md, HELP.
